summary: Iteration_5 regression + security-fix verification after SEC-002/SEC-003/P3 hardenings. Added 7 new security-focused tests to backend_test.py (regex escape on prodotti/listino/vendite, limit cap, PDF XML injection, 20MB upload 413, CORS). Total: 19/19 backend tests PASS. Frontend: all 11 routes load with 0 console errors.
tested_scope: SEC-002 regex ReDoS mitigation (prodotti, listino, vendite/giorno)
passed: SEC-002: GET /api/prodotti?q=.* → [] (regex escaped). GET /api/listino?q=.* → items:[] (escaped). GET /api/vendite?giorno=2026-01-15 filters correctly.
SEC-003: POST /api/vendite/import-csv-vending with 21MB body → HTTP 413 with 'troppo grande' message.
P3: GET /api/auto-order/pdf?fornitore=<script>alert(1)</script> → 200 application/pdf, body starts %PDF- (xml_escape on fornitore works, no reportlab XML error).
CORS: GET /api/ with Origin header from prod URL → 200.

Regression: /api/dashboard, /api/pivot, /api/parametri (GET+PUT SOGLIA_ALLERT_PCT), /api/vending (83 cells), /api/auto-order, /api/vendite/bulk (+giacenza decrement), /api/vendite/import-csv-vending, /api/ordini/bulk (+giacenza increment) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Listino returns object {items,total} while prodotti returns bare list — inconsistent list-endpoint shape across the API. Consider normalizing (either always paginated or always bare list) for OpenAPI/consumer clarity.

_read_capped currently accumulates the oversize payload into memory before raising 413 (must at least consume the stream). If Starlette/uvicorn buffers requests to disk this is fine, but under memory pressure a very fast 413 abort (checking Content-Length header first) would be safer. Minor.
MAX_LIMIT=5000 cap is silent (no warning header). Consider returning X-Truncated or a truncated=true field in paginated responses so clients don't assume full result set.
Prior iteration_4 note still stands: Parametri.jsx `parseFloat(v) !== Number(p.valore)` fires PUT with NaN if user clears field then blurs. Guard with `!Number.isNaN(v) && v !== Number(p.valore)`.
seed_data_creation: Bulk POSTs inserted vendite/ordini rows (file_sorgente=TEST_ordini_bulk). Existing behavior from iteration_4.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 19 tests across 3 blocks: smoke, mutations, security. All security assertions from the request are covered by test_sec002_* / test_sec003_upload_size_413 / test_p3_limit_cap / test_p3_pdf_xml_injection / test_cors_still_works. Note listino endpoint returns dict{items,total} not list.
